notes: Bitcoin Cooler: the separate BCLR launch token grants no claim on strategy assets. Deploy the five application contracts in the listed dependency order. LoopPosition accounts are created by LoopAccountDeployer when users create LoopReceipt positions, so no shared LoopPosition is deployed at launch. Application constructors configure immutable dependencies and grant no administrator role; there are no initialization calls or privileged wallet arguments. External addresses and freshness bounds reproduce the Ethereum reference snapshot at block 26070119 recorded in docs/deployment.md; they have not been reverified for a live deployment. These Ethereum addresses do not supply integrations on Sepolia. Constructors can succeed on an empty chain, but deposits require compatible deployed dependencies and passing runtime validation. The composite feed uses WBTC/BTC and BTC/USD with maximum ages of 90000 and 7200 seconds; LoopConfig allows 90000 seconds. External protocol governance, oracle freshness, liquidity, loan health and receipt ownership govern strategy operation; deployment success does not prove operational readiness. The launch pool pairs BCLR with native ETH, has no hook, and uses decimal sqrtPriceX96. The factory supplies liquidity and MerkleDistributor; effective opening pricing remains subject to launch policy.
